tradition_assertions.notes: The EOTC catalogue lists a book with this title. Brenton's text is an English translation of the Greek Septuagint; this record does not claim it is the same textual witness, an EOTC edition, or a translation from the bundled Geʽez text.

witness.title: English companion — Brenton Septuagint (1851), Psalms
witness.date_statement: Translation published 1851; USFM source package provided by eBible.org
witness.repository_or_publisher: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton; digital text distributed by eBible.org
witness.editorial_policy: USFM verse labels, footnotes, cross-references, paragraph starts (\p), descriptive-title markers (\d), and translator-supplied-word markers are retained. USFM formatting markers for small capitals are flattened to plain text; \add words are wrapped in visible archival brackets.

coverage.structure_description: The archived eBible.org USFM member contains 151 ordered chapters, 2535 numbered labels, and 88 preserved unnumbered continuation segments; this is a count of the selected digital source package, not proof of printed-edition completeness.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: 311 footnotes and cross-references retained. The USFM \add marker for translator-supplied words is rendered as visible ⟦brackets⟧; source \p paragraph starts and \d descriptive-title markers are retained before source-labeled units, and inline unnumbered \p text is stored separately as continuation segments on the preceding verse; small-cap formatting is flattened to plain text.
coverage.numbering_policy: Source chapter and verse labels are retained as strings. Shared labels pair witnesses for navigation only; verse-level alignment with the Geʽez text has not been established.

rights.statement: eBible.org's source notice identifies Brenton's 1851 English translation as public domain. The archive records this provider claim; it is not a worldwide legal determination and does not apply to other text layers or eBible.org page design.
rights.territory_or_term_limits: Provider-reported public-domain status; no jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction determination is claimed.
